description: This Java interface defines the Container contract within the OFBiz framework, specifying lifecycle methods such as init, start, stop, and getName for background container processes.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: An interface representing a container process in OFBiz, managing its lifecycle methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with command-line arguments, a unique name, and configuration file info.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container process, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.
